site.name: Hirakud Reservoir
site.study_area_note: Fixed reservoir segment; not the complete reservoir boundary.

limitations: Fewer than 80 training dates: experimental prototype; readiness gate not met.
No independent event labels: event accuracy and warning lead time are unknown.
Anomaly scores are not flood probabilities. Surface area is not storage volume.
Fixed study rectangles may include other water bodies; these are not surveyed reservoir boundaries.
Seasonal fit has fewer than two full annual cycles in the training period.

provenance: Real NASA OPERA DSWx-HLS observations; cached locally.
